messages:
Maria L.: Heads-up — we need a quick crawl-priority + redirects plan for the webinar launch landing pages. Marketing wants pages crawled fast, but we also have duplicates from tracking params and old vanity URLs. Can someone propose a short checklist and ownership?

Devon K.: +1. I'll sketch rules:
- canonical tags on all variants -> point to clean URL (no UTM)
- 301 consolidate old vanity -> canonical target (preserve utm via querystring if needed)
- sitemap: include only canonical URLs, give webinar pages higher <priority> temporarily
- robots: allow, but throttle via crawl-delay not ideal — prefer sitemap + Search Console submit

Ashwin (Demand Gen): Important: we need UTMs preserved for funnel attribution. If we 301 remove them, sales/GTMs lose source. Can we append UTM on redirect so Salesforce still sees it?

Devon K.: Yes — do a 301 that keeps querystring. Example NGINX rule: 
```
# preserve query string
rewrite ^/old-vanity$ /webinar/clean-url permanent;
```
That will forward ?utm_source=... automatically. For our app-level redirects we need to ensure client doesn't strip params.

Leo S.: Content/links side: we'll collapse duplicate content: create one canonical landing, remove near-duplicates, then add internal links from blog + docs to the canonical URL. Also add rel=prev/next for series if there are multiple pages.

Maria L.: Good. What about schema for the webinar page (event, attendance, speaker)? We want rich results and a clear meta for social.

schema-bot: automated-check: webinar schema missing speaker.name and startDate format. Suggestions: add Event schema with startDate in ISO8601 and Organizer info. Severity: minor -> medium.

Devon K.: Quick JSON-LD snippet we can hand to content: 
```
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference Launch Webinar",
  "startDate": "2024-06-10T16:00:00Z",
  "location": "Online",
  "performer": {"@type": "Person", "name": "Sasha R."}
}
```
Add same info to OpenGraph meta.

Ashwin (Demand Gen): For inbound lead routing: we need UTM + webinar_id persisted in the sign-up flow and forwarded to SFDC. I can work with Eng to add hidden fields. Can we set a cookie on first click and keep it through redirect chain?

Devon K.: Yep set a 30d cookie on first access with utm params + webinar_id. Server-side reads cookie on form submit. Also set canonical to the URL without params but keep cookies so analytics works.

Leo S.: Small SEO tweak: add link rel=\"alternate\" hreflang only if we have localized pages. Otherwise skip to avoid confusing crawl.

Maria L.: Action items then:
- Devon: write redirect rules + canonical guidelines, share PR for nginx/app redirects (owner) — due EOD tomorrow
- Leo: consolidate content + update internal linking doc, add JSON-LD to the content template — due in 2 days
- Ashwin: spec the cookie + SFDC hidden fields and confirm with sales ops — due tomorrow
- Ops: submit sitemap update to Search Console after PRs merged

Devon K.: I'll create a small checklist in the shared sheet and add examples for 301s, canonical tags, and nginx vs app-level handling. ping @Maria L. when ready.

Ashwin (Demand Gen): I'll confirm the SFDC field names today. Also want to A/B test keeping UTMs in URL vs cookie-only for shareability.

Maria L.: Sounds good. If anyone sees blockers (CSP, CDN rewrite limitations) flag here. Thanks :thumbsup:

Leo S.: Quick note — if we need immediate crawling, I'll request Indexing API + temporary priority in sitemap for the week of launch.

schema-bot: follow-up scan scheduled in 12h after changes.

Devon K.: Added checklist row: \"preserve querystring on 301s, ensure canonical without params, set Vary headers? (no)\" — will attach sample redirect rules in the PR.

Maria L.: Perfect. I'll mark this thread owner as Marketing launch lead for follow-up.

(reacts: :eyes: :white_check_mark: )
